name: Apartio
description: Apartio collects rental listings from Serbian sites, removes duplicates and translates them. Save a search and get new matches on the web or in Telegram.
features: Listings collected from Serbian rental sites
Saved searches with new matches on the web or in Telegram

deletion.note: Delete your account in Account settings on search.apartio.rs, or email support@apartio.rs from the account's address; it's deleted within 30 days.
